name: audio_pitch_harmonics
expr: f220 = pitch(x220, fs); f100 = pitch(x100, fs); h220 = harmonicRatio(x220, fs); pn220 = numel(f220); hn220 = numel(h220); f220_first = f220(1); f220_mean = mean(f220); f100_mean = mean(f100); h220_mean = mean(h220); fcep220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'CEP'); cep_first = fcep220(1); cep_2 = fcep220(2); cep_4 = fcep220(4); cep_mean = mean(fcep220); fpef220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'PEF'); pef_first = fpef220(1); pef_mean = mean(fpef220); xmix = sin(2*pi*220*t) + 0.5*sin(2*pi*100*t); fpef_range = pitch(xmix, fs, 'Method', 'PEF', 'Range', [80 250]); pef_r_first = fpef_range(1); flhs220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'LHS'); lhs_first = flhs220(1); lhs_2 = flhs220(2); lhs_mean = mean(flhs220); fsrh220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'SRH'); srh_first = fsrh220(1); srh_n = numel(fsrh220);
comment: MATLAB Audio Toolbox cycles E/F/K/K-2/K-3/K-4 + L: pitch + harmonicRatio. ALL 5 MATLAB pitch methods now shipped: NCF (default cycle E), CEP (K — bit-equal), PEF (K-2 — bit-equal), LHS (K-3 — bit-equal), SRH (K-4 — algorithmic-equal ~1Hz/frame diff in some frames due to FP-ordering in LPC overlap-add). Cycle F: harmonicRatio gained MATLAB parity (auto low-edge + Smith parabolic). Cycle L (partial): 'Range' Name-Value arg. Cycle K-4 SRH: 25ms/5ms internal framing → hann periodic → LPC(12) per frame → filter(A,1,y) inverse → overlap-add residual → reframe with default WindowLength/OverlapLength → blackman periodic → fft(_, round(fs)) → domain[freq]=E[freq]+Σ_{m=2..5}(E[m·freq]-E[round((m-0.5)·freq)]) → max idx as f0. 18/18 fingerprints OK. pitchnn deferred (DNN runtime not in numkit). Tolerance 5% for algorithmic methods (NCF, SRH); CEP/PEF/LHS bit-equal.
